parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic, representing the Earth's surface with printed maps. It is approximately 25 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It displays geographical information and can be rotated to view different regions of the world.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, typically made of metal, providing stability and support for the rotating sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the sphere in place and allows it to rotate smoothly while maintaining balance.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed support for the rotating sphere.
